panels.title: Training history with diagnostics ON / OFF

options.content:
**Diagnostics OFF:** Grafana itself may be unavailable. Prometheus and Alertmanager remain baseline services; progress, loss samples, checkpoint lineage and security/mutation audit must remain durable. Use authenticated [job history](/api/v1/admin/training/jobs). Select a returned job ID to read `/api/v1/admin/training/jobs/{job_id}/metrics`, `/events` and `/checkpoints`; paginate all results. IDs belong in authorized API history, never metric labels.

**Diagnostics ON:** this dashboard shows aggregates; use local Tempo/Loki for trace/log attribution if those destinations are enabled. Prometheus is not a loss-history database. No data means unknown, not zero or healthy.

**Release status:** full hardware matrix, diagnostics-on/off delivery and baseline snapshot instrumentation are pending; feature 016 is not complete. [Baseline wiring and gates](/docs/runbooks/sft-training#baseline-wiring).

panels.description: Persisted snapshot gauge; requires scheduler polling task. Distinguish queue reasons in authenticated job detail; event counters are not queue depth.
panels.title: Training queue and durable states

panels.description: Recovery includes uncertain process ownership; no other job's progress can clear this oldest-age signal. Unknown ownership age is a conservative attempt-creation bound.
panels.title: Attempt stalls and recovery uncertainty

panels.description: Durable means independently verified full common bundle on both Studios and fenced metadata commit. Inspect per-copy status through job checkpoints API.
panels.title: Checkpoint replication and commit age

panels.description: Persisted guard gauge requires all-rank stop proof. Insufficient/stale latency samples block admission but are not fabricated latency breaches.
panels.title: Chat / memory protection deadline failures

panels.description: Existing placement gauge; training footprint inclusion still needs verification. Drift alone is not a no-swap measurement or coexistence approval.
panels.title: Shared memory ledger drift

panels.description: Actual telemetry helper counters. Sample counts do not represent loss values, job counts, recovery success or checkpoint durability. Durable losses retain attempt/update boundaries.
panels.title: Persisted event and loss-sample activity

panels.description: Baseline poll must run even when training is disabled. Missing data is unknown; CoireTrainingBaselineUnavailable alerts independently of diagnostic storage.
panels.title: Baseline observation freshness

panels.description: Any failed request makes the strict phase inconclusive. Reasons distinguish occupied concurrency, completion timeouts, identity mismatch and completion errors; prompts and exception contents are excluded.
